description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the KpiDao class in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It contains unit tests for CRUD operations and specific functionalities related to Kpi data access, using fixtures and mocking where necessary.

classes.name: KpiDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the KpiDao class methods related to KPI management in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin.
